title: Strict simultaneous DVR reduction models and residue triangles
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $k=R/(\varpi)$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $C_n=(R/\varpi^n)_X$ for $n\geq1$, let $q_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n$ be the quotient maps, and put $B=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}C_n$ with projections $\pi_n:B\to C_n$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Write $Q$ for localization from cochain complexes of $B$-module sheaves to $D(\operatorname{Mod}(B))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For any $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B))$ there is a K-flat complex $P$ with flat $B$-module terms and an isomorphism $Q(P)\simeq K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Set $P_n=\operatorname{Res}_{\pi_n}(P\otimes_B C_n)$, using termwise sheaf tensor and restriction of scalars [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. There are simultaneous isomorphisms $Q(P_n)\simeq K_n:=\operatorname{Res}_{\pi_n}(K\otimes_B^L C_n)$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] under which the actual chain maps $t_n=1_P\otimes q_n:P_{n+1}\to P_n$ are the canonical derived quotient transitions. For every $n\geq1$, the $B$-linear map $u_n:C_1=k_X\to C_{n+1}$ induced on constant coefficients by $\bar r\mapsto\varpi^nr\bmod\varpi^{n+1}$ gives a degreewise short exact sequence of complexes of $B$-modules
$$0\longrightarrow P_1\xrightarrow{1_P\otimes u_n}P_{n+1}\xrightarrow{t_n}P_n\longrightarrow0.$$
Consequently there is a distinguished triangle [def-weil-triangulated-category]
$$K_1\longrightarrow K_{n+1}\xrightarrow{\bar t_n}K_n\longrightarrow K_1[1]$$
whose second arrow is the same canonical quotient transition $\bar t_n=Q(t_n)$ under the simultaneous identifications. No completeness, cohomological bound, constructibility, or quasi-compactness hypothesis on $K$ or $X$ is imposed.
